[b][color=#f4cccc][size=5][font=Courier New]How to Make Tapioca Pearls[/font][/size][/color][/b]

[font=Courier New]1. [i][b][size=4]Tapioca Starch[/size][/b][/i] — Put Cassava in the Mill to make Tapioca Starch.[/font]

[font=Courier New]2. [i][b][size=4]Secret Woods Spring Water[/size][/b][/i] — First, craft an Empty Springwater Bottle. You’ll find it under “Other” in the crafting menu. Hold the empty bottle and collect water from any pond or river in the Secret Woods. One empty bottle gives you five bottles of Secret Woods Spring Water.[/font]

[font=Courier New]3. [i][b][size=4]Kuromitsu[/size] [/b][/i]— Cook Brown Sugar, any Honey, and Secret Woods Spring Water to make this rich brown sugar syrup.[/font]

[font=Courier New]4. Put one Tapioca Starch, one Kuromitsu, and one Secret Woods Spring Water into a Preserves Jar. Seven hours later, you’ll get three chewy tapioca pearls![/font]
